name: -8AN ORB to 3/8" Quick Connect
title: -8AN ORB to 3/8" Quick Connect
description:
The -8AN ORB to 3/8" Quick Connect is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. the ORB quick connect is now available in Black

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Sealing Type: Viton O-Ring Boss (ORB) positive seal to prevent thread sealant contamination.
• Quick Connect: High-pressure fuel rail latch mechanism.
